key_insight: EPRO optimizes an unobserved execution policy through an imperfect predictor, using prediction risk to limit how aggressively the learner updates.
engineering_relevance: EPRO addresses policy differences between rollout and training engines that can arise even when they share model parameters.
method: Predict the current execution policy from the observed rollout-time policy and training-policy changes.
Use the predictor’s score to obtain Transported Score Centering (TSC).
Estimate prediction risk with Policy Shift and attenuate risky updates using Shift-Aware Soft Clipping (SSC).
evidence_signal: Across four Qwen3 model settings and seven mathematical reasoning benchmarks, EPRO achieves the highest average held-out accuracy among the compared methods.
watch_item: Policy Shift is a proxy for prediction risk; the abstract does not establish how reliably it tracks prediction error across other models or execution engines.
paper_title: EPRO: Robust Policy Optimization Through an Imperfect Execution-Policy Predictor
